title: Những giờ nhung
about: Round 41, thu-vien ("tôi thấy không hay, bạn hãy sáng tác theo ý của bạn và dùng bộ sound phù hợp"), Nocturnes for an Old Library, Velvet Hours: the soft, slow hours of the night, C minor at 48 bpm, the slowest: a chorale, the tune in half notes and whole notes over soft chords rolled once a bar in the middle (texture chord); the middle in Eb major. The piano alone, on thu-vien (ke-chuyen-gan's grand, hall and echo, with nothing heavy: no Rhodes, the lows not lifted, the left hand from C3 with no octave); a singing line in periods, a question and an answer, each return varied; soft, a gentle swell in the middle, no climax. An original tune.
